title: Single-prescriber pharmacies and their prescribers elsewhere (checked)
question: Do the prescribers and drug billers flagged by the new drug screens turn up in City pay, contract or influence screens?
finding: The 4 individual prescribers behind pharmacies drawing most of their Medicaid drug money through one number were searched by full name in every other screen: 0 found. Of 11 private drug billers flagged by the new drug screens, 11 appear outside the Medicaid screens: CBHS PHARMACY SERVICES (health_records: Drug money and the State pharmacy permit at the same address); KAISER FOUNDATION HEALTH PLAN INC (fedmoney: Firms the City pays that settled or admitted federal fraud matters; fedmoney: Federal campaign gifts from the staff of City payees; health_records: Drug money and the State pharmacy permit at the same address and 7 more); MISSION AREA HEALTH ASSOCIATES, INC (health_records: San Francisco addresses with the most separate Medicare group practices); NORTH EAST MEDICAL SERVICES (chains: Would the tests have caught the known cases?; exceptions: The largest contracts awarded without competition; exceptions: Declared the only possible source and 10 more); PLANNED PARENTHOOD SHASTA DIABLO, INC. (rings: The linked groups; rings: Linked groups where nobody has looked; statemoney: State grants to organizations that already carry warning signs); SAN FRANCISCO STATE UNIVERSITY STUDENT HEALTH SERVICES (health_records: Drug money and the State pharmacy permit at the same address; rings: What was removed as a hub, and why); SCRIPTSITE PHARMACY PARTNERS LLC (health_records: Drug money and the State pharmacy permit at the same address); SF ROYAL MEDICAL SUPPLY, INC (health_records: Drug money and the State pharmacy permit at the same address); SOLANO PHARMACY (health_records: Drug money and the State pharmacy permit at the same address); WALGREEN CO (health_more: Who receives industry research money in San Francisco; health_records: Drug money and the State pharmacy permit at the same address; leaks: Settlements in which the City is paid and 6 more); WALGREEN CO. (health_more: Who receives industry research money in San Francisco; health_records: Drug money and the State pharmacy permit at the same address; leaks: Settlements in which the City is paid and 6 more).
how: Prescriber names (individual clinicians) and private billing organizations from the three medical_claims drug screens looked up by normalised full name in every published row outside medical_claims and medicaid. Prescribers are counted, not listed.
limits: A clinician who serves a clinic's patients is expected to write most of a nearby pharmacy's prescriptions. The City pay file is by name and a common name would match a different person, so only a full-name test is used and no person is shown.

rows.item: Private drug billers flagged by the new drug screens
